The [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Lazhae]] operated out of a '''laboratory''' in the [[Shadow Town]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] complex on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] while imprisoned there during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
